entries.claim: The selected macro supplies the full Per eundem conclusion and response Amen. Speaker markers are framing; no independent print or live-runtime verification is claimed.
The pinned proper supplies its literal 27-word prayer and selects $Per eundem. The full macro is a separately declared part of this one derived comparison.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
The full conclusion is supplied by the printed rubric, with the eundem modification separately required by RG115b. The witness retains the rubric’s unaccented spelling and list-final semicolon.

locator.section: RG115b, Per eundem when the Son was named earlier

entries.claim: The rubric prescribes Per eundem when the Son was mentioned earlier, as in this proper. It modifies the full RG115a conclusion, not the prayer body.
